About Arizona Spiritual Retreats

Discover meditation centers, wellness facilities, and spiritual retreats across Arizona

What This Directory Covers

Arizona Spiritual Retreats lists 36 spiritual retreat centers, meditation facilities, and wellness organizations across 21 Arizona cities. Each listing includes publicly available business information such as address, phone, website, hours, and ratings.

We focus on places whose primary purpose involves spiritual practice, meditation, retreats, or contemplative programming. Generic spas, vacation rentals, and unrelated businesses are excluded during our classification process.

Data Source & Freshness

Scraped from Google Business Profiles (September 2024). We deduplicate listings by phone and address, keeping the higher-reviewed version when duplicates are found. Data is updated manually and reflects business information as of the date shown in the footer.

Ranking Methodology

Listings are sorted using a Bayesian average rather than raw star ratings. This prevents a retreat with a single 5-star review from outranking one with hundreds of 4.9-star reviews. The formula blends each listing's rating with the dataset average, weighted by review count:

score = (PRIOR × datasetMean + n × rating) / (PRIOR + n)

The displayed star rating is always the unmodified original. The Bayesian score is used only for sort order. Featured listings are pinned to the top of their city page and clearly labeled.

Exclusion Criteria

We classify each potential listing as core (retreat-focused), adjacent (spiritually related), or excluded (generic categories like vacation rentals or standard spas). Only core and adjacent listings appear in the directory.

Important Notice

Nothing on this site constitutes professional spiritual advice, medical advice, or an endorsement. Listings reflect business information from public sources; inclusion does not verify credentials, licensing, or legitimacy. Always verify business details directly and consult appropriate professionals for health or legal matters.
